text:
Hey team,

The nightly job failed because the server's disk was 98% full and the job had no room to write its output. Log rotation was turned off back in January, so logs piled up every day until the disk ran out of space. It slipped through the cracks; nobody's at fault.

We cleared out the old logs, which freed 40 GB, then reran the job. It finished successfully at 02:40.

Log rotation is back on, so this shouldn't happen again. We're also looking at adding a disk usage alert to catch it earlier next time.

Thanks for flagging this. I can share details on the cleanup or the alert setup if anyone wants them.
